title: Find and Jump
description: Get anywhere in a few keys: f t ; , for characters, { } for paragraphs, % for brackets, and counts.

levels.title: Little Bobby Tables
levels.description: Find the first ';' in this perfectly innocent input.
levels.hint: f followed by a character jumps to its next occurrence on the line.

levels.title: Close, but not quite
levels.description: Stop on the last letter of 'isAdmin', right before the ')'.
levels.hint: t followed by a character stops just before it.

levels.title: Again and again
levels.description: Land on the third comma, the moment before any code happens.
levels.hint: Find the first comma with f, then ; repeats the last find (and , repeats it backwards).

levels.title: Paragraph hopping
levels.description: Skip ahead to the blank line right before Chapter 3.
start_text: Chapter 1: It was a dark and stormy sprint.
levels.hint: } jumps to the next blank line, { to the previous one.

levels.title: Matchmaker
levels.description: Put the cursor on the '}' that closes the if block.
levels.hint: % jumps to the bracket matching the one under (or after) the cursor.

levels.title: Count on it
levels.description: Excuse number 7 is the real one. Get to the start of its line without pressing j seven times.
levels.hint: Most motions take a count: 7j moves down seven lines.
